mark.discovery: Homepage rel=icon and apple-touch-icon use the 150px and 300px variants of this official compact C mark.
mark.treatment: Original pixels retained; proportionally resized and placed on charcoal. Android static splash vector traces the alpha boundary with 0.45px maximum contour simplification; no letterform redesign.

photo.treatment: Existing verified exhibition image; full image contained within a cinematic background band, with live SVG charcoal/red overlays. No portrait crop, stock or AI imagery.
